driver_archetypes.rationale: Saval et al. 2023 Table 11 (Car): calibrated parameters for compliant Hanoi drivers; high tau and low accel/decel reflect cautious car behaviour.
Custom2 car violators drawing from the 'car' distribution; currently compliant (p=0) to match M3/share/car low red-running and M2/early/car near-zero early start.
Saval et al. 2023 Table 11 (Motorcycle): calibrated parameters; minGapLat=0.3 is the lower bound to allow close following observed in Hanoi.

Custom1 motorcycle violators drawing from the 'moto' distribution; currently compliant (p=0) for rules to avoid sidewalk usage and wrong-lane riding while keeping base behaviour identical to moto_saval.
Illegal left-turning motorcycles (distribution moto_violator); jmTimegapMinor=1.0 is the default for gap acceptance before illegal entry; behaviour relies on TraCI rules.

traci_rules.rationale: Matches Saval et al. 2023 Sec 4 (front-row motorcycle red-running probability ~0.5); k=0 reflects no swarm pressure observed in the specific footage used for calibration.
Targets M2/early/moto (observed share 0.1303); p=0.13 approximates the probability of creeping over the stop line in the last 10s of red, with v_max=2 m/s limiting speed to slow rolling.

Targets M8/moto wrong-lane share (0.2131) and M9a (queue blocking); q=50m triggers seeking at moderate queues, t_g_s=7s estimates green clearance, p_wrong_lane=0.21 sets the observed wrong-lane share; est_noise provides slight estimation error.
Field observation: most motorcycles pass a standing U-turner; p=0.8 captures high bypass probability, t_wait=2s is the short hold before deciding.
Field observation: cars rarely bypass standing U-turners; p=0.1 reflects low probability compared to motorcycles.
